Your chakra reserves run deeper than most can imagine. Once per day, when you would expend a Focus Point to cast a focus spell or to sustain a jutsu of 1st-rank or higher, you may choose not to spend that resource; you must complete a full 10-minute rest before benefiting from this feature again.
